roles.title: Product Manager
roles.location: New York, New York, United States

bullets: Own end-to-end platform delivery for fund requirements through engineering, QA, and go-live. You are accountable for the fund platform success, not just features shipped
Partner with stakeholders to evaluate requests, translate priorities into system-aware platform requirements based on ROI, risk reduction, and scalability
Conduct user interviews and workflow observation sessions with stakeholders. Requirements must come from direct observation, not stakeholder translation.
Collaborate with engineering to understand system constraints, evaluate build tradeoffs, and deliver features that reduce risk and enable opportunities across funds
Lead scoping of critical workflows, defining interface requirements, and coordination across internal and external teams
